text:
Ellie: CloudHarbor wants a joint marketplace feature + integration how-to + short benchmarking post. Short sprint — 3 deliverables. Who picks owners?

Raj: I can own the marketplace listing + metadata. Need CloudHarbor logo (SVG), a 1200x600 hero, two-line blurb, and a 60s demo. Request from partner: publish window week of July 6.

Priam (CloudHarbor): We can provide logos and a co-branded hero by Jun 28. CloudHarbor can host a short demo clip if you supply a script. We can also amplify via our partner newsletter.

Tessa: I'll draft the benchmark + methodology post. Plan: include latency and cost-per-token delta for prefix-heavy chat with Redwood caching vs baseline. Need perf runs and sample prompts.

MKTG-OPS-BOT: Marketplace readiness checklist posted in #ops-templates. Required: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags.

Design: Can produce hero + social cards and help edit the 60s clip. Need headline + 3 bullets by next Tue.

Ben (Sales): I'll draft the AE one-pager and objection FAQ. Also want lead routing: marketplace leads -> Partner queue with partner tag and source metadata.

Ellie: Two priority asks: (1) webinar title options by EOD Tue, (2) AE 1-pager template (top 5 objections + demo link).

Raj: Quick lead routing snippet for ops - please implement: 

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=cloudharbor
campaign=cloudharbor_co_launch_jul2026
sfdc_owner=Partner_Ops_CloudHarbor
lead_queue=partners_cloudharbor
utm_source=cloudharbor_marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=cloudharbor_co_launch_jul2026
```

Tessa: For benchmark, I'll run three configs: baseline, Redwood caching, Redwood + CloudHarbor regional routing. If we see >2x improvement on regional latency, that'll be our callout. Will post numbers by Fri.

Priam (CloudHarbor): CloudHarbor can provide a short customer quote and help promote webinar. Legal will need to pre-clear any named customer references.

Ben (Sales): AE template fields I'll include: lead_source, partner, product_area, urgency, contact, demo_recording_link, suggested_next_steps. Will post draft tomorrow.

Ellie: Action owners recap:
- Raj: marketplace listing + metadata (owner)
- Tessa: benchmark post + methodology (owner)
- Design: hero + social + video edit (owner)
- Ben (Sales): AE one-pager + lead routing mapping (owner)
- Priam (CloudHarbor): partner assets + newsletter amp (partner)

Ellie: Promo cadence suggestion: announce (2wks), reminder 7d, reminder 2d, last-chance 1h. Also require standardized webinar UTM across partner assets. Any blockers?
